beginner.title: Get started with Marvelous Designer
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Marvelous Designer, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Navigate 3D space
beginner.outcome: You can: move around and select confidently
beginner.practice: Navigate and measure a sample scene

beginner.title: Model simple objects
beginner.practice: Model a chair or a room

intermediate.title: Materials and lighting
intermediate.outcome: You can: make models look real

intermediate.title: Render and present
intermediate.outcome: You can: produce images or walkthroughs
intermediate.practice: Render three views for a client

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Marvelous Designer
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Marvelous Designer distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Marvelous Designer
expert.outcome: You can: use Marvelous Designer's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Animate and optimise
expert.outcome: You can: animate and optimise scenes

expert.title: Integrate Marvelous Designer into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Marvelous Designer with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Marvelous Designer to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Marvelous Designer well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Marvelous Designer" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
